2608.26334.title: ProofEvolve: Neuro-Symbolic Evolution for Formal Automated Theorem Proving
2608.26334.paper_summary: Automated theorem proving offers a natural foundation for recursive self-improvement in scientific discovery. However, existing neural provers do not fully preserve this recursive structure, where the learning process should be self-improving over time. Existing methods either embed proof experience into model parameters through expensive weight updates, or keep verified intermediate deductions only within the current problem. In addition, these methods also heavily rely on sparse whole-proof feedback, even when unsuccessful partial attempts contain useful discoveries. To close the gap, we propose ProofEvolve, a neuro-symbolic framework that evolves explicit, formally verified symbolic proof structures with neural models to decisively expand the knowledge boundary. In this framework, the neural model proposes variation operators, including decompositions, repairs, and schema recombinations. The symbolic Lean kernel verifies every proof transition. Over the evolution loops, ProofEvolve computes verified closure over the resulting proof directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). Within each problem, ProofEvolve evolves partial AND-OR proof DAGs in a behaviorally indexed archive. Across problems, kernel-checked schema extraction adds newly proved sub-DAGs to a persistent schema library. Proof DAGs inherit the solved results through typed schema recombination, with every residual premise exposed as a new subgoal. This evolutionary process preserves verified results from incomplete attempts and makes them available for later proofs without weakening formal soundness. Across three competition-level Lean benchmarks, ProofEvolve achieves the highest average solve rate among the evaluated proof systems.
2608.26334.paper_summary_zh: 自動定理證明為科學發現中的遞歸自我改進提供了自然的基礎。<lb/>然而，現有的神經證明器並未完全保留這一遞歸結構，學習過程應該隨著時間自我改進。<lb/>現有的方法要麼通過昂貴的權重更新將證明經驗嵌入模型參數中，要麼僅在當前問題中保留經過驗證的中間推導。<lb/>此外，這些方法也在很大程度上依賴稀疏的整體證明反饋，即使不成功的部分嘗試中也包含有用的發現。<lb/>為了縮小這一差距，我們提出了ProofEvolve，一個神經符號框架，通過神經模型發展明確的、形式上經過驗證的符號證明結構，以果斷擴展知識邊界。<lb/>在這個框架中，神經模型提出變化運算子，包括分解、修復和模式重組。<lb/>符號Lean內核驗證每一個證明過渡。<lb/>在演化循環中，ProofEvolve計算結果證明有向無環圖（DAG）的驗證閉合。<lb/>在每個問題中，ProofEvolve在行為索引存檔中演化部分AND-OR證明DAG。<lb/>在不同問題之間，內核檢查的模式提取將新證明的子-DAG添加到持久的模式庫中。<lb/>證明DAG通過類型模式重組繼承已解決的結果，並將每個剩餘前提暴露為新的子目標。<lb/>這一演化過程保留了不完全嘗試的驗證結果，並使其在後續證明中可用，而不削弱形式的健全性。<lb/>在三個競賽級Lean基準測試中，ProofEvolve在評估的證明系統中實現了最高的平均解決率。
